est_products: 315 parent products (274 variable, 41 simple); finish-level SKUs live in variations
sku_format_match: yes - finish SKUs like CL-206-AB appear as the variation attribute 'Fixture Number' (or 'Lamp Number' for lamps). Parent sku field = base (CL-206); some variation 'sku' fields are wrong/duplicated (e.g. variation 6484 sku=CL-206B-BK but Fixture Number=cl-206-ab; CL-752B-SI variation sku=CL-752B), so match on the attribute, not variation.sku. Several simple lamp products (L-EDBA-2.5W, L-ED16-5W-BT) have an empty sku and the SKU is the product name. 12/12 samples located (10 CL-* by variation attribute, L-EDBA-2.5W and L-ED16-5W-BT by product name).

sample_tests.note: simple product, empty sku field, matched by name

recommended_strategy: Page the Store API (4 requests) to get all parents; for each variable parent iterate `variations[]` and read attribute 'Fixture Number'/'Lamp Number' (uppercase) as the SKU; GET /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products/<variation_id> for the variation image (images[0].src). For simple products use sku, or name when sku is empty. Fallback: parent images[] whose filename contains the SKU (e.g. CL-206-AB.jpg). Normalize case and strip WP '-e<digits>' edit suffixes when comparing filenames.
